title: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. translated_title: 基于大语言模型起草的角色类型化信号时序逻辑规范生成安全关键驾驶场景
translated_abstract: 在记录的真实驾驶数据中，安全关键场景十分罕见，因此必须通过生成的方式来测试和训练自动驾驶车辆的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型都需要各自独立的加权目标函数，且与有效性检查相互分离。若将攻击者与被测车辆一起优化，被测车辆可能消除攻击或将攻击引向自身。我们将每种场景表述为带有按角色分类子句的信号时序逻辑规范。每个子句都指明它所改变的主体和它所读取的主体，且被测车辆仅在攻击发生后才开始读取攻击者的信息。大语言模型根据文字描述起草该规范，并由类型检查器进行验证。编译器推导出相应的优化过程：通过对扩散模型的样本进行满足规范的最小改动来编辑样本，每个子句仅移动其所属主体，攻击者在被测车辆作出响应之前先针对未响应的被测车辆进行求解……
tldr: 该论文提出由大语言模型从描述中起草按角色分类的信号时序逻辑规范，再由编译器将其转化为对扩散模型样本的最小编辑优化，从而生成安全关键驾驶场景，用于测试自动驾驶车辆的运动规划器。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes using large language models to draft role-typed signal temporal logic specifications from descriptions, which a compiler translates into minimal-edit optimizations of diffusion model samples to generate safety-critical driving scenarios for testing automated vehicles' motion planners.
